headline: A 2004 executive order directing federal agencies to share more information about terrorism to help protect Americans.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order aims to improve how terrorism-related information is shared, most likely among government agencies. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, duties, and limits it set are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that collect or use terrorism-related information
who_it_affects.how: They would likely be directed to share terrorism information more widely or more effectively.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 27, 2004; no separate start date was provided.
